# Vendor Info: Diff2Html

- **Project**: [Fast diff-to-HTML generator (parser + renderer, no UI/highlight wrapper)](https://github.com/rtfpessoa/diff2html)
- **Version**: 3.4.56
- **License**: MIT
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/diff2html)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `vendor/updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Select **Diff2Html** from the dropdown menu.
3. Click "Download" and select this local directory (`vendor/diff2html/`) when prompted.
4. The tool will automatically update this `_VENDOR-INFO.md` file.
5. Update the version number in the root [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md).

**Files maintained by the updater**
* `js/diff2html.min.js`
* `css/diff2html.min.css`
